comment: Independent C-first check that a fatal broken-wand explosion ends the command: a debug Tourist without a pet wishes for a wand of fire and breaks it (apply.c do_break_wand()), and the fireball from broken_wand_explode()'s explode() kills her. She answers yes to the debug Die? question, quits the disclosure, and saves bones. end.c done() does not return in C, so broken_wand_explode() never reaches makeknown() or discard_broken_wand(), whose delobj() would draw obj_resists().
